status_note: A starting point derived from the requirements, for review. No table has been created.

entities.name: Person
entities.purpose: Anyone who uses or works on CRIS: TxDOT users and staff, contract managers, vendor staff and administrators.
fields: TxDOT user, TxDOT staff member, TxDOT manager, TxDOT contract manager, system administrator, developer, compliance officer, procurement officer, risk manager, security officer

entities.name: SupportTicket
entities.purpose: An issue a user reports through the help desk, and its resolution.

entities.name: TicketEvent
entities.purpose: The audit trail of a ticket: every change, by whom and when. STORY-001 requires every help desk interaction to be logged.

entities.name: HealthSample
entities.purpose: One measurement of how CRIS is performing, taken by the monitoring tools.
fields: for example response time or availability

entities.name: Incident
entities.purpose: An outage, failure or operator error, from detection to resolution, with its reference in the incident management system.
fields: id in the incident management system

entities.name: Report
entities.purpose: A generated report: performance, incident resolution, compliance, or one the contract manager specifies.
fields: performance, incident log, compliance, contract-specified, risk assessment

entities.name: Feedback
entities.purpose: Something a user says about CRIS, collected so it can shape new features.

entities.name: FeatureChange
entities.purpose: A new feature or change to CRIS, and the feedback or operational need that led to it.
fields: the user feedback or operational need

entities.name: TrainingSession
entities.purpose: A training session for TxDOT staff on new functionality, or the vendor cyber security training.

entities.name: TrainingAttendance
entities.purpose: Who attended a session and whether they completed it.

entities.name: ComplianceRule
entities.purpose: A federal, state or local law or rule CRIS has to comply with.
fields: the law or rule it comes from

entities.name: ComplianceCheck
entities.purpose: One check of CRIS against a rule, with its result and evidence.

entities.name: CostEntry
entities.purpose: A cost or payment line exchanged with TxDOT's financial systems for reporting and compliance checks.

entities.name: SolicitationResponse
entities.purpose: A response to the solicitation, and its submission and tracking through the procurement system.
fields: draft, submitted, under evaluation, awarded, not awarded

entities.name: ResponseDocument
entities.purpose: A document that belongs to a response.
fields: for example technical proposal, pricing, forms

entities.name: ScoringCriterion
entities.purpose: One criterion in TxDOT's weighted scoring system, with its weight.

entities.name: EvaluationScore
entities.purpose: One evaluator's score for one response against one criterion.

entities.name: Risk
entities.purpose: A risk to CRIS from performance problems, user error, outages or operator error, with its mitigation.
fields: performance, user error, outage, operator error, security
